buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic

Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder to provide Past performance experience in the any of PSU / Central State Government Sector to b e provided with satisfactory letters. 2. OEM should have at least 10 years of experience in PC manufacturing and the corresponding certific ate to be produced at the time of bidding and in the last 3 financial years with an annual turnover of average 1 000 cr or above. 3. The Bidder & OEM should not have been blacklisted by any Government Dept/PSU/Banks currently. 4. There should not be any open incident on the GeM portal against Bidder and OEM. 5. Bidder should have an office in Gujarat from past 7 years. Valid proof of the office agreement to be prov ided. 6. Land border declaration to be uploaded by bidder & OEM as per Compliance of Restrictions under R ule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017. 7. OEM should have ISO certification (related document to be submitted). 8. Vendors who quote on behalf of OEMs should enclose valid authorization letter bid specific. 9. OEM to have an online warranty check for the model of desktop (online warranty link along with decl ara tion to be enclosed). 10. Service Support: Drivers should be available for download from OEM site. OEM must have an online /off line system hardware diagnostics facility and facility to download updates of software, device drivers, and firmware on its website. 11. Bidder to submit Make & Model Brochure of the quoted desktop and same model should be available o n OEM Website. Generic Brochure is not acceptable. 12. Bid specific Technical Specifications Compliance on OEM letter head with Gem bid number, contact det ails (Email ID, Contact Number, etc) of authorized Signatory.
